SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) as holdout_member_count
FROM campaign_holdout
WHERE campaign_id = 15

-- Targeted members (have sales during campaign period, not in holdout)
WITH campaign_period AS (
  SELECT '2025-11-24'::DATE as campaign_start, '2025-11-30'::DATE as campaign_end
),
targeted_members AS (
  -- All members with marketing consent at campaign start, excluding holdout
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
  FROM dim_member m
  CROSS JOIN campaign_period cp
  WHERE m.valid_from <= cp.campaign_start AND m.valid_to >= cp.campaign_start
    AND m.marketing_consent = TRUE
    AND m.member_id NOT IN (
      SELECT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id = 15
    )
),
holdout_members AS (
  SELECT member_id
  FROM campaign_holdout
  WHERE campaign_id = 15
),
targeted_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    f.member_id,
    SUM(f.net_amount) as total_net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  INNER JOIN targeted_members tm ON f.member_id = tm.member_id OR (f.member_id IS NULL AND tm.member_id IS NULL)
  WHERE f.sale_date >= '2025-11-24' AND f.sale_date <= '2025-11-30'
  GROUP BY f.member_id
),
holdout_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    f.member_id,
    SUM(f.net_amount) as total_net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  INNER JOIN holdout_members hm ON f.member_id = hm.member_id
  WHERE f.sale_date >= '2025-11-24' AND f.sale_date <= '2025-11-30'
  GROUP BY f.member_id
)
SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT tm.member_id) as targeted_members_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT hm.member_id) as holdout_members_count,
  COALESCE(AVG(ts.total_net_sales), 0) as avg_spend_targeted,
  COALESCE(AVG(hs.total_net_sales), 0) as avg_spend_holdout
FROM targeted_members tm
FULL OUTER JOIN targeted_sales ts ON tm.member_id = ts.member_id
FULL OUTER JOIN holdout_members hm ON 1=1
FULL OUTER JOIN holdout_sales hs ON hm.member_id = hs.member_id

-- Get targeted members and their spend
WITH targeted_member_keys AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_key, m.member_id
  FROM dim_member m
  WHERE m.valid_from <= '2025-11-24' AND m.valid_to >= '2025-11-24'
    AND m.marketing_consent = TRUE
    AND m.member_id NOT IN (
      SELECT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id = 15
    )
),
holdout_member_keys AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_key, m.member_id
  FROM dim_member m
  INNER JOIN campaign_holdout ch ON m.member_id = ch.member_id
  WHERE ch.campaign_id = 15
    AND m.valid_from <= '2025-11-24' AND m.valid_to >= '2025-11-24'
),
targeted_sales_by_member AS (
  SELECT 
    tmk.member_id,
    SUM(f.net_amount) as total_net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  INNER JOIN targeted_member_keys tmk ON f.member_key = tmk.member_key
  WHERE f.sale_date >= '2025-11-24' AND f.sale_date <= '2025-11-30'
  GROUP BY tmk.member_id
),
holdout_sales_by_member AS (
  SELECT 
    hmk.member_id,
    SUM(f.net_amount) as total_net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  INNER JOIN holdout_member_keys hmk ON f.member_key = hmk.member_key
  WHERE f.sale_date >= '2025-11-24' AND f.sale_date <= '2025-11-30'
  GROUP BY hmk.member_id
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) FROM targeted_member_keys) as targeted_members,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) FROM holdout_member_keys) as holdout_members,
  ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(total_net_sales, 0)), 2) as avg_spend_targeted,
  (SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(total_net_sales, 0)), 2) FROM holdout_sales_by_member) as avg_spend_holdout
FROM targeted_sales_by_member

-- Verify campaign member counts
SELECT 
  campaign_id,
  campaign_name,
  mailing_list_size,
  holdout_size,
  (mailing_list_size - holdout_size) as targeted_size,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_id) as actual_holdout_count,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) 
   FROM dim_member m 
   WHERE m.valid_from <= '2025-11-24' AND m.valid_to >= '2025-11-24'
     AND m.marketing_consent = TRUE) as consent_member_count
FROM dim_campaign dc
LEFT JOIN campaign_holdout ch ON dc.campaign_id = ch.campaign_id
WHERE dc.campaign_id = 15
GROUP BY dc.campaign_id, dc.campaign_name, dc.mailing_list_size, dc.holdout_size

-- Calculate average spend per member in each group
WITH holdout_member_ids AS (
  SELECT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id = 15
),
targeted_sales AS (
  SELECT SUM(f.net_amount) as total_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  INNER JOIN dim_member m ON f.member_key = m.member_key
  WHERE f.sale_date >= '2025-11-24' AND f.sale_date <= '2025-11-30'
    AND m.member_id NOT IN (SELECT member_id FROM holdout_member_ids)
    AND m.valid_from <= '2025-11-24' AND m.valid_to >= '2025-11-24'
    AND m.marketing_consent = TRUE
),
holdout_sales AS (
  SELECT SUM(f.net_amount) as total_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  INNER JOIN dim_member m ON f.member_key = m.member_key
  WHERE f.sale_date >= '2025-11-24' AND f.sale_date <= '2025-11-30'
    AND m.member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM holdout_member_ids)
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(ts.total_sales / 23826.0, 2) as avg_spend_per_targeted_member,
  ROUND(hs.total_sales / 2747.0, 2) as avg_spend_per_holdout_member,
  ROUND((ts.total_sales / 23826.0) - (hs.total_sales / 2747.0), 2) as uplift_in_euros
FROM targeted_sales ts
CROSS JOIN holdout_sales hs

-- Verify totals and transaction counts
WITH holdout_member_ids AS (
  SELECT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id = 15
)
SELECT 
  'Targeted' as group_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) as members_with_sales,
  COUNT(*) as transaction_count,
  SUM(f.net_amount) as total_net_sales,
  ROUND(AVG(f.net_amount), 2) as avg_transaction_value
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_member m ON f.member_key = m.member_key
WHERE f.sale_date >= '2025-11-24' AND f.sale_date <= '2025-11-30'
  AND m.member_id NOT IN (SELECT member_id FROM holdout_member_ids)
  AND m.valid_from <= '2025-11-24' AND m.valid_to >= '2025-11-24'
  AND m.marketing_consent = TRUE
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Holdout' as group_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) as members_with_sales,
  COUNT(*) as transaction_count,
  SUM(f.net_amount) as total_net_sales,
  ROUND(AVG(f.net_amount), 2) as avg_transaction_value
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_member m ON f.member_key = m.member_key
WHERE f.sale_date >= '2025-11-24' AND f.sale_date <= '2025-11-30'
  AND m.member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM holdout_member_ids)
